name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
summary: Low-interest loans for building post-harvest facilities (cold storage, warehouse, pack house, sorting/grading) and community farming assets.

benefits.headline: 3% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹2 crore, for up to 7 years
details: Banks lend for viable projects and the Government pays a 3% a year interest subvention on up to ₹2 crore, for a maximum of 7 years.
Loans up to ₹2 crore get a credit guarantee (CGTMSE), so collateral is generally not required.
Can be combined with other government subsidies. The facility runs until FY 2032-33.

summary: Individual farmers, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs, PACS, cooperatives, agri-entrepreneurs and start-ups can apply.
You need a viable project for post-harvest infrastructure or a community farming asset, for example a warehouse, cold store, pack house, sorting/grading unit, silo, or polyhouse.
The project must be approved by your bank.

rules.label: You are a farmer
rules.pass_text: You are registered as a farmer in KisanAI.
rules.fail_text: Individual farmers, groups and farm enterprises can apply.
rules.unknown_text: Add your farm details so we can check this.

verify: You must have a bankable project plan with land available for the facility. Banks assess viability before sanctioning.

adjust.reason: Perishable crops like yours benefit from cold storage and pack houses
Groups can pool resources for shared facilities

documents.name: Detailed project report or project plan
Land ownership or lease documents for the project site
Bank statements and income tax returns (if available)

steps: Prepare a simple project report with cost estimates and expected income.
Register and apply on the AIF online portal, or approach a participating bank branch.
Select a bank; the bank appraises your project and sanctions the loan.
Interest subvention is applied by the bank. Keep your repayment schedule on time.
offline: Nearest bank branch (commercial, cooperative or regional rural bank)
District Agriculture / Horticulture office for help with the project report

deadline.text: Open throughout the year until FY 2032-33.

caveats: This is a loan scheme for infrastructure projects, not a grant for everyday farming expenses.
